evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring future cadence and frames an unreharsed rollback as a hypothetical gap, stating a general principle rather than a specific event.
Labels a specific planned recurring activity — named artifact (Atlas) and concrete event type (rehearsals) scheduled ahead.
Asserts a current, settled assignment of a named individual to a role — present actual state.
